statement.p: Calculate the flux integral. \int_S (3 \vec i + 2 z\vec k)\cdot d\vec A where S is z = x^2+y^2 with 0\le x\le 1, 0\le y\le 3, oriented upward.

static.solution: z=x^2+y^2, we have z_x=2x and z_y=2y, so d\vec A=(-2x\vec i -2y\vec j +\vec k)\,dx\,dy. Thus \int_S (3 \vec i + 2 z\vec k)\cdot d\vec A = \int_0^{3}\int_0^{1} (3 \vec i + 2(x^2+y^2)\vec k)\cdot (-2x\vec i-2y\vec j +\vec k)\,dx\,dy, = \int_0^{3}\int_0^{1}(-6 x+ 2 x^2+ 2 y^2)\,dx\,dy = \int_0^{3}\left(-3 x^2 + \frac{2}{3} x^3 + 2 xy^2\right)\Bigg|_0^{1}\,dy = \int_0^{3} \frac{-7}{3} + 2 y^2\, dy = \frac{-7}{3} y + \frac{0}{3} y^3\bigg|_0^{3} = 11.
